configurePresets.name: conf-light_mk4-host-debug
configurePresets.description: The host tree: registers one ctest that runs `cargo test` over the portable crates, so scripts/test.ps1 and CI reach the Rust tests the same way they reach every other project's.

configurePresets.name: conf-light_mk4-pico2-debug
configurePresets.description: The bare Pico 2 in the po13 rig's SWD dock: the same C shell with an LED-and-console Rust app, flashed and debugged over SWD. Exists to answer the debugger questions the touch169 cannot.

configurePresets.name: conf-light_mk4-touch169-debug
configurePresets.description: The spike firmware on the Waveshare RP2350-Touch-LCD-1.69: pico-sdk C shell + Rust staticlib. Rust_CARGO_TARGET is the soft-float ABI to match pico-sdk's -mfloat-abi=softfp.

configurePresets.name: conf-light_mk4-touch169-release
configurePresets.description: The touch169 firmware with cargo's release profile (opt-level s, fat LTO): Corrosion takes the profile from CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE. Separate tree, so the debug one stays warm.

configurePresets.name: conf-light_mk4-pico2-riscv-debug
configurePresets.description: The po13 rig built for the RP2350's Hazard3 RISC-V cores: LIGHT_ARCH picks the ISA and pico-sdk's own RISC-V toolchain file, Rust_CARGO_TARGET is the matching soft-float rv32imac target. PICO_TOOLCHAIN_PATH comes from light-env.ps1 (the RISC-V toolchain is kept off PATH; see screen-test's riscv preset for the whole story).

configurePresets.name: conf-light_mk4-touch169-riscv-debug
configurePresets.description: The touch169 built for the Hazard3 cores; see the pico2 riscv preset.

configurePresets.name: conf-light_mk4-mini-stm32h7-debug
configurePresets.description: WeAct MiniSTM32H7xx (STM32H743VIT6) on bare CMSIS: the CMSIS shell with the Rust app on the board's ST7735. Inherits conf-light-base rather than a Pico base, since PICO_* means nothing here; the arm-none-eabi toolchain comes from mk3's toolchain file, selected by its preinit before project(). Rust_CARGO_TARGET is the hard-float Cortex-M7 target, matching -mfloat-abi=hard.

configurePresets.name: conf-light_mk4-crossfire-debug
configurePresets.description: crossfire on the po13 rig: the Pico 2's native USB port hosting USB-MIDI instruments, the OLED as the status display, the console on the UART through the debug probe. Flashed and debugged over SWD.

configurePresets.name: conf-light_mk4-pico2-release
configurePresets.description: The po13 rig with the release profile.
